sentences.zh: 俄屬尚藥進丸藥不稱旨，茂因奏莊不親監，帝怒。

translations.literal: Soon the Office of Imperial Pharmacy presented pills that did not suit the imperial will, and Mao thereupon memorialized that Zhuang had not personally supervised; the Emperor was angry.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Office of Imperial Pharmacy presented pills that did not suit the imperial will, and Mao thereupon memorialized that Zhuang had not personally supervised; the Emperor was angry.

sentences.zh: 十一年，徐璒等反於江南，詔莊以行軍總管長史，隨軍討之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Xu Yan and others rebelled in Jiangnan; an edict made Zhuang Chief Clerk to the Campaigning Regional Commander to follow the army in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Xu Yan and others rebelled in Jiangnan; an edict appointed Zhuang Chief Clerk to the Campaigning Regional Commander to follow the army in suppression.

sentences.zh: 璒平，即授饒州刺史，甚有能名。

translations.literal: When Yan was pacified, Zhuang was at once appointed Governor of Rao Province and had a considerable reputation for ability.
translations.idiomatic: When Yan was pacified, Zhuang was at once appointed Governor of Rao Province and won a considerable reputation for ability.

sentences.zh: 卒於官。

translations.literal: He died in office.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office.

sentences.zh: 論曰：韓褒奉事三帝，以忠厚知名。

translations.literal: The commentary says: Han Bao served three emperors and was known for loyalty and honesty.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: Han Bao served three emperors and was known for loyalty and honesty.

sentences.zh: 趙肅平允當官，張軌循良播美，李彥譽流省閣，郭彥信著蠻貃，曆官出納，並當時之選也。

translations.literal: Zhao Su was fair and upright in office; Zhang Gui spread the fame of good governance; Li Yan's reputation flowed through the inner offices; Guo Yan's trustworthiness was known among the barbarians of the frontier; in successive posts of receipt and disbursement they were all the choice men of their age.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Su was fair and upright in office; Zhang Gui spread the fame of good governance; Li Yan's reputation flowed through the inner offices; Guo Yan's trustworthiness was known among the frontier barbarians; in successive posts of receipt and disbursement they were all the choice men of their age.

sentences.zh: 梁昕、皇甫璠、辛慶之、王子直、杜杲之徒，並關右之舊族。

translations.literal: Liang Xin, Huang Fufan, Xing Qingzhi, Wang Zizhi, Du Gao, and their kind were all old clans of Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Xin, Huang Fufan, Xing Qingzhi, Wang Zizhi, Du Gao, and their kind were all old clans of Guanzhong.

sentences.zh: 或紆組登朝，獲當官之譽，或張旃出境，有專對之才，既茂國猷，克隆家業，美矣！

translations.literal: Some, trailing ribbons, ascended court and won praise in office; some, unfurling banners, went beyond the borders and had the talent to answer alone on behalf of the state. They enriched the state's plans and cloned the family enterprise—beautiful indeed!
translations.idiomatic: Some, trailing ribbons, ascended court and won praise in office; some, unfurling banners, went beyond the borders and had the talent to answer alone on behalf of the state. They enriched the state's plans and carried on the family enterprise—beautiful indeed!

sentences.zh: 魏文帝云「文人不護細行。」

translations.literal: Emperor Wen of Wei said: "Men of letters do not guard minor conduct."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen of Wei said, "Men of letters do not guard minor conduct."

sentences.zh: 其呂思禮之謂乎！

translations.literal: Was this not meant of Lu Sili!
translations.idiomatic: Was this not meant of Lu Sili!

sentences.zh: 徐招、檀翥、孟信各以才學自業，又加之以清介，並志能之士也。

translations.literal: Xu Zhao, Tan Zhu, and Meng Xin each made talent and learning their profession, and to this added purity and integrity—they were all men of resolve and ability.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Zhao, Tan Zhu, and Meng Xin each made talent and learning their profession, and to this added purity and integrity—they were all men of resolve and ability.

sentences.zh: 宗懍才辭幹局，見重梁元，逮乎播越秦中，不預政事，豈亡國俘虜不與圖存者乎？

translations.literal: Zong Lin had talent in composition and capacity in affairs and was valued by Emperor Yuan of Liang; when he reached exile in Qin he did not participate in government—was this not because a captive of a fallen state does not join in plans for survival?
translations.idiomatic: Zong Lin had talent in composition and capacity in affairs and was valued by Emperor Yuan of Liang; when he reached exile in Qin he did not participate in government—was this not because a captive of a fallen state does not join in plans for survival?

sentences.zh: 梁氏據有江東五十餘載，挾策紀事，蓋亦多人。

translations.literal: The Liang house held the lands east of the Yangtze for more than fifty years; in holding brushes to record events, there were surely many men.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang house held the lands east of the Yangtze for more than fifty years; in holding brushes to record events, there were surely many men.

sentences.zh: 劉璠學思通博，有著述之譽，雖傳疑傳信，頗有詳略，而屬辭比事，為一家之言。

translations.literal: Liu Fan's learning and thought were broad and penetrating and he had a reputation for authorship; though in transmitting doubt and transmitting certainty he was somewhat detailed or brief, in arranging words and comparing events he formed a school of his own.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Fan's learning and thought were broad and penetrating and he had a reputation for authorship; though in transmitting doubt and certainty he was somewhat detailed or brief, in arranging words and comparing events he formed a school of his own.

sentences.zh: 行本正色抗言，具存乎骨鯁。

translations.literal: Xingben's stern countenance and bold speech are fully preserved in his unyielding bones.
translations.idiomatic: Xingben's stern countenance and bold speech are fully preserved in his unyielding bones.

sentences.zh: 柳遐立身之道，進退有節，觀其眷戀墳隴，其孝可移於朝廷；

translations.literal: In Liu Xia's way of establishing himself, advance and retreat had measure; seeing his attachment to tombs and hills, his filial piety could be transferred to the court;
translations.idiomatic: In Liu Xia's way of establishing himself, advance and retreat had measure; seeing his attachment to tombs and hills, his filial piety could be transferred to the court;

sentences.zh: 盡禮舊主，其忠可事於新君。

translations.literal: in exhausting ritual toward his old lord, his loyalty could serve the new ruler.
translations.idiomatic: in exhausting ritual toward his old lord, his loyalty could serve the new ruler.

sentences.zh: 夫能推此類以求賢，則知人幾于易矣。

translations.literal: If one can extend this kind of example to seek the worthy, then knowing men is nearly easy.
translations.idiomatic: If one can extend this kind of example to seek the worthy, then knowing men is nearly easy.

sentences.zh: 莊亮直之風，不殞門表，忠而獲謗，蓋亦自古有之。

translations.literal: Zhuang's bright and upright wind did not fade from the family's banner; loyalty yet receiving slander—this too has existed from ancient times.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuang's bright and upright wind did not fade from the family's banner; loyalty yet receiving slander—this too has existed from ancient times.
